description: Returning customers sign in with the email address they registered. A refusal has to be visible and has to say nothing about which half of the credential was wrong.
acceptanceCriteria: The sign-in form labels its fields "Email address *" and "Password *".
Signing in with a valid email and password opens the account page at the path /account.
Once signed in, the navigation shows the account menu in place of the "Sign in" link.
Signing in with a wrong password leaves the customer on the sign-in page and shows an error message.
The error message for a wrong password does not say whether the email address is registered.
